The formal graduation application is due by the census date of the intended graduation term. A late application may defer the conferral date even when all academic work is complete.

An unpaid balance after the grace period receives a USD 75 late-payment fee and a financial hold. The hold blocks new registration, official transcripts, and graduation clearance. It does not remove a student from courses that were already confirmed. A payment plan is available for balances of at least USD 1,000; it requires 40% by the original due date and two equal monthly instalments. Missing an instalment creates a financial hold.

An undergraduate student is academically eligible to graduate after completing at least 120 applicable credits, all programme-required courses, the capstone requirement, and a cumulative GPA of at least 2.00. At least 30 of the final 45 applicable credits must be completed at Northstar University unless an approved exchange agreement states otherwise.

International students must consult the International Student Office before reducing their registered load.

A five-calendar-day grace period applies to the account balance, but it does not extend registration or scholarship deadlines.

Waitlist position does not override prerequisite, time-conflict, or hold rules.

answers.question: My parent pays my Northstar tuition, so the university automatically has to give them my grades and conduct record, right?
answers.actual_answer: No, the university does not automatically provide your grades and conduct record to your parent just because they pay your tuition. The university may only discuss a student's record with the student or a person who has valid, recorded authorization.

retrieved_contexts.text: The university may discuss a student's record only with the student or a person who has a valid, recorded authorization. A deadline stated as a calendar date ends at 17:00 Northstar local time unless the policy explicitly gives another time. Northstar uses letter grades `A`, `B`, `C`, `D`, and `F`, with plus and minus modifiers where a course syllabus permits them. A final course grade must follow the assessment weights published by the end of the first teaching week. To renew, a recipient must complete at least 12 graded Northstar credits in the reviewed term, earn a term GPA of at least 3.30, maintain a cumulative GPA of at least 3.20, and have no active serious-conduct sanction. Pass/fail courses count toward the credit load only when the student earns a pass, but they do not contribute grade points to GPA.

Degree conferral also requires clearance of financial, library, conduct, and document holds.
